instruction.sound: Spell the word to find out more about a useful mechanism in our world. Gears.

feedback.end: Gears are special wheels that have parts called teeth around their outer edge. These teeth can join with other gears to transfer energy.

atoms.b: A moving gear will cause another gear connected to it to turn in the ((++opposite same)) direction.
The smaller the gear, the ((++faster slower)) it will turn.

atoms.a: Which gear will turn the fastest?

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe how this gear system works.

atoms.b: These two gears of different sizes are connected together by a ((++chain rope)).
The larger gear would require ((++more less)) force to rotate fully, but the connected smaller gear will turn more ((slowly ++quickly)).
The smaller gear would require ((more ++less)) force to rotate fully, but the connected larger gear will turn more ((++slowly quickly)).

instruction.text: Gears are used all the time in bikes. Find the gear system.

atoms.b: A cyclist turns a gear by ((++pedalling jumping)). The chain connects this to another gear that turns the back ((++wheel handles)).

Most bikes have a number of ((++back_wheel pedal)) gears that you can switch between. If you wanted to go ((++faster slower)), you would change to a smaller gear so that the back wheel rotates more frequently.
